Description:
Description
Rich, Intense Color
Shape, Line & Define Lips
Lipliner has made a comeback in a big way. Whether is overlining, or entirely reshaping lips, these trends are here to stay and Perfect Precision Lipliner is here to help. Create perfectly precise lines to customize your lip shape without tugging, skipping or crumbling on lips. Not too soft, yet not too waxy, it’s the goldilocks of lipliner formulas. Fill in your lips and wear it alone or layer your lipstick on top to lock in color for long lasting wear. Each lip pencil is made of wood from sustainable forests so you can feel good about the products in your bag, while looking good too.
Suggested use
Trace along lip lines for the top and bottom lip.
Fill in lips for extended lipstick wear.
Sharpen before each use for the most precise lines.
Other ingredients
C10-18 triglycerides, talc, hydrogenated vegetable oil, caprylic/capric triglyceride, synthetic japan wax, bht, mica, methylparaben, propylparaben. may contain: iron oxides (ci 77491, ci 77492, ci 77499), titanium dioxide (ci 77891), yellow 5 lake (ci 19140).
Warnings
In case of irritation, discontinue use.

A show-stopping, one-swipe, transformative liquid eyeshadow designed to deliver a multifaceted, multidimensional, multi-chrome finish. This innovative liquid and jelly hybrid nourishes while amplifying your eyes to the next dimension with color shifting technology.
Why It's Good For You
Lustrous Diamond Dust creates a light-reflective effect that leaves veil of color-shifting brilliance. Soothing Mineral Water and nourishing Vitamin E transform your eyelids, leaving them feeling smooth to the touch.
Key Ingredients
Lustrous Diamond Dust (100% certified authentic diamonds)
Soothing Mineral Water
Nourishing Vitamin E
Suggested use
Apply to the eyelids using the applicator or fingertip. Wear alone or as a topper to amplify your eye look.

Description
Radiant pop of color. Indulge in buildable pigments. Weightless feel. A lit-from-within glowy or dewy natural finish. Suitable for all skin types.

Suggested use
Gently remove excess product from applicator.
Use the doe-foot applicator and place 1-3 dots on each cheek.

Build blush to desired level of color and coverage by repeating steps 2 and 3.
